name: Data Driven Design
description: Students will understand how to use data and AI as creative and critical tools in the design process. Prototype AI-enabled experiences (e.g. personalization, classification, generation). Reflect on the ethical and systemic implications of data-driven and AI-based interventions. Work with Indian datasets and real-world scenarios (urban, rural, socio-technical).
